description: At a shop near Jogyesa in central Seoul, a merchant pressed a button on a key ring. It played the hollow tapping sound of a wooden instrument used in Buddhist rituals. Shoppers have been buying these key rings as good-luck gifts for students taking South Korea’s college entrance exam. “The sound of the moktak puts you at ease. description: Since September, a painting by the Korean artist Paek Yunzo has hung under the same roof as a bronze lion by Takashi Murakami and cat figures from ancient Egypt. Her 2024 oil painting "Free Riders" is one of more than 300 works on view in "So Cute! The Art of Happiness," a wide-ranging survey of cuteness in art that runs through Jan. 18 at the Louvre-Lens, the Louvre’s regional branch in the former coal-mining town in northern France. title: After Louvre-Lens, Paek Yunzo opens two-person show in Seoul

description: JEJU CITY — Separating a fresh Gueom chicken egg takes patience. The fresher the egg, the more stubbornly the yolk clings to the white, and the hens that lay them produce only about one egg every three days. Those eggs, and the slender, free-range birds that lay them, are at the center of Kkokkio Gyorae, a new food tour set in Gyorae-ri, a village in Jocheon-eup, Jeju City, which was designated a native chicken distribution special zone in 2009. title: At Jeju Island's Gyorae, one native chicken makes a meal

description: As South Korea's traditional kimjang season approaches, an annual festival is underway at Imsil Cheese Theme Park in North Jeolla Province, offering visitors a chance to prepare kimchi using locally grown ingredients. Kimjang is a traditional Korean practice of making large quantities of kimchi in late autumn or early winter to prepare for the colder months. description: South Korea fell to Saudi Arabia 3-2 in their men's football friendly match in Qatar on Friday, their first loss to the Middle Eastern foe in 21 years. Saudi Arabia, world No. 55, struck first late in the first half before scoring twice in a three-minute span in the second half for the victory at Jassim bin Hamad Stadium in Al Rayyan, just west of the Qatari capital of Doha.
